契约: input_files=[], output_files=['clean.csv']
规则:
  - 按 order_id 去重，保留首条
  - revenue 或 cost 缺失的订单剔除
  - 不剔除毛利为负的有效订单
注意: 本数据为【模拟数据】，不代表任何公司真实经营情况。
"""
import io
import pandas as pd

# ---- 模拟数据（内嵌，明确标注为模拟数据）----
RAW_CSV = """order_id,month,revenue,cost
X01,2026-05,250,120
X02,2026-05,750,600
X02,2026-05,750,600
X03,2026-05,,25
Y01,2026-06,1300,950
Y02,2026-06,400,440
Y03,2026-06,300,90
Z01,2026-07,2000,1200
Z02,2026-07,1000,700
Z03,2026-07,500,
"""

print("=" * 60)
print("【模拟数据】订单明细清洗（非真实经营数据）")
print("=" * 60)

raw = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(RAW_CSV), dtype={"order_id": str, "month": str})
raw["revenue"] = pd.to_numeric(raw["revenue"], errors="coerce")
raw["cost"] = pd.to_numeric(raw["cost"], errors="coerce")

n_raw = len(raw)
print(f"原始记录数: {n_raw}")

# ---- 1) 按 order_id 去重，保留首条 ----
dup_mask = raw.duplicated(subset=["order_id"], keep="first")
dup_count = int(dup_mask.sum())
dup_ids = raw.loc[dup_mask, "order_id"].tolist()
print(f"重复记录数(按 order_id 保留首条): {dup_count}  重复 order_id: {dup_ids}")

dedup = raw.loc[~dup_mask].copy()

# ---- 2) 剔除 revenue 或 cost 缺失的订单 ----
miss_mask = dedup["revenue"].isna() | dedup["cost"].isna()
miss_count = int(miss_mask.sum())
miss_ids = dedup.loc[miss_mask, "order_id"].tolist()
print(f"缺失记录数(revenue 或 cost 缺失): {miss_count}  缺失 order_id: {miss_ids}")

clean = dedup.loc[~miss_mask].copy()

# ---- 3) 计算毛利，保留负毛利有效订单（不剔除）----
clean["gross_profit"] = clean["revenue"] - clean["cost"]
neg = int((clean["gross_profit"] < 0).sum())
print(f"清洗后记录数: {len(clean)}")
print(f"其中毛利为负的有效订单数(保留): {neg}")

# ---- 血缘核对：清洗前后数量守恒 ----
assert len(clean) == n_raw - dup_count - miss_count, "数量守恒校验失败"
print(f"数量守恒校验通过: {n_raw} - {dup_count}(重复) - {miss_count}(缺失) = {len(clean)}")

# ---- 落盘 ----
clean.to_csv("clean.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print("已写出: clean.csv")
print("=" * 60)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
步骤2：读取 clean.csv（前序产物），按 month 汇总，输出 monthly_summary.csv
注意：本步骤不重新生成原始数据，只读取真实文件 clean.csv。
数据性质：模拟数据（非公司真实经营数据）。
金额单位：元。
"""
import os
import sys
import pandas as pd

# ============ 中文字体配置（本步骤不出图，但保留统一配置） ============
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

INPUT_FILE = "clean.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "monthly_summary.csv"
TOL = 1e-8

# ---------- 1. 读取前序产物，缺失即报错，禁止重造数据 ----------
if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
    sys.exit(f"[ERROR] 缺少约定输入文件 {INPUT_FILE}，本步骤拒绝重造数据。")

clean = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)
print(f"[INFO] 读取 {INPUT_FILE}：{len(clean)} 行，列={list(clean.columns)}")

# 契约校验：clean.csv 必须包含所需列
required = {"order_id", "month", "revenue", "cost"}
missing_cols = required - set(clean.columns)
if missing_cols:
    sys.exit(f"[ERROR] clean.csv 缺少必需列：{missing_cols}")

# 规避陷阱：clean.csv 应已去重且无缺失；此处做防御性检查并 print 结论
dup_cnt = int(clean.duplicated(subset=["order_id"]).sum())
na_rev = int(clean["revenue"].isna().sum())
na_cost = int(clean["cost"].isna().sum())
print(f"[CHECK] clean.csv 重复 order_id 数={dup_cnt}（应为0）；revenue缺失={na_rev}，cost缺失={na_cost}（应为0）")
if dup_cnt > 0 or na_rev > 0 or na_cost > 0:
    sys.exit("[ERROR] clean.csv 未满足清洗契约（去重/无缺失），请检查前序步骤。")

# 数值化，防止字符串
clean["revenue"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["revenue"], errors="coerce")
clean["cost"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["cost"], errors="coerce")
if clean["revenue"].isna().any() or clean["cost"].isna().any():
    sys.exit("[ERROR] clean.csv 存在无法转为数值的 revenue/cost。")

# ---------- 2. 按 month 汇总（不复制原始数据重算） ----------
# 规避陷阱：毛利率用「总毛利/总收入」，绝不对单笔毛利率取平均
grp = clean.groupby("month", as_index=False).agg(
    revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
    cost=("cost", "sum"),
    orders=("order_id", "nunique"),   # 订单数按唯一 order_id 计
)
grp["gross_profit"] = grp["revenue"] - grp["cost"]
# 毛利率：总毛利 / 总收入；总收入为0时置为 NaN 避免除零
grp["gross_margin"] = grp.apply(
    lambda r: (r["gross_profit"] / r["revenue"]) if r["revenue"] != 0 else float("nan"),
    axis=1,
)

# 列名严格为：month,revenue,cost,gross_profit,gross_margin,orders
monthly = grp[["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]].copy()
monthly = monthly.sort_values("month").reset_index(drop=True)

# ---------- 3. 核对：按月汇总之和 == 清洗明细合计（绝对容差 1e-8） ----------
sum_rev = float(monthly["revenue"].sum())
sum_cost = float(monthly["cost"].sum())
sum_profit = float(monthly["gross_profit"].sum())
det_rev = float(clean["revenue"].sum())
det_cost = float(clean["cost"].sum())
det_profit = det_rev - det_cost

ok_rev = abs(sum_rev - det_rev) <= TOL
ok_cost = abs(sum_cost - det_cost) <= TOL
ok_profit = abs(sum_profit - det_profit) <= TOL
print(f"[VERIFY] 收入合计 汇总={sum_rev:.6f} 明细={det_rev:.6f} 一致={ok_rev}")
print(f"[VERIFY] 成本合计 汇总={sum_cost:.6f} 明细={det_cost:.6f} 一致={ok_cost}")
print(f"[VERIFY] 毛利合计 汇总={sum_profit:.6f} 明细={det_profit:.6f} 一致={ok_profit}")
if not (ok_rev and ok_cost and ok_profit):
    sys.exit("[ERROR] 月度汇总与清洗明细合计不一致，血缘校验失败。")

# 逐月毛利率再校验（总毛利/总收入）
for _, r in monthly.iterrows():
    if r["revenue"] != 0:
        expect = r["gross_profit"] / r["revenue"]
        assert abs(expect - r["gross_margin"]) <= TOL, f"{r['month']} 毛利率校验失败"
print("[VERIFY] 各月毛利率 = 总毛利/总收入，校验通过（未使用单笔毛利率平均）。")

# ---------- 4. 打印关键结果 ----------
print("\n[RESULT] 月度汇总（模拟数据，金额单位：元）")
print(monthly.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\n[RESULT] 月份数={len(monthly)}，总订单数={int(monthly['orders'].sum())}，"
      f"总收入={sum_rev:.2f}，总成本={sum_cost:.2f}，总毛利={sum_profit:.2f}")

# ---------- 5. 落盘 ----------
monthly.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(f"\n[SAVED] {OUTPUT_FILE}（模拟数据，金额单位：元）")

# 中文字体（本机可用 Microsoft YaHei / SimHei）
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# ============ 本步骤职责：读取 monthly_summary.csv -> figure.svg + report.md ============
# 数据来源声明：全部为【模拟数据】，不代表任何公司真实经营情况。

INPUT_MONTHLY = "monthly_summary.csv"
INPUT_CLEAN = "clean.csv"
OUT_FIG = "figure.svg"
OUT_REPORT = "report.md"

# ---- 1. 契约校验：缺失约定输入必须报错，禁止重造数据 ----
for f in [INPUT_MONTHLY, INPUT_CLEAN]:
    if not os.path.exists(f):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少约定输入文件：{f}，本步骤禁止重造数据。")

# ---- 2. 读取月度汇总（只读，不重算原始数据）----
ms = pd.read_csv(INPUT_MONTHLY)
required_cols = ["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]
missing_cols = [c for c in required_cols if c not in ms.columns]
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"monthly_summary.csv 缺少列：{missing_cols}")

ms = ms.sort_values("month").reset_index(drop=True)

# ---- 3. 血缘一致性核对：月度汇总总额 vs 清洗明细总额（容差 1e-8）----
clean = pd.read_csv(INPUT_CLEAN)
clean_rev = float(clean["revenue"].sum())
clean_cost = float(clean["cost"].sum())
clean_orders = int(clean["order_id"].nunique())

sum_rev = float(ms["revenue"].sum())
sum_cost = float(ms["cost"].sum())
sum_orders = int(ms["orders"].sum())

tol = 1e-8
rev_ok = abs(clean_rev - sum_rev) < tol
cost_ok = abs(clean_cost - sum_cost) < tol
orders_ok = (clean_orders == sum_orders)

print("=== 血缘一致性核对（容差 1e-8）===")
print(f"收入: clean={clean_rev:.2f} vs monthly={sum_rev:.2f} -> {'一致' if rev_ok else '不一致'}")
print(f"成本: clean={clean_cost:.2f} vs monthly={sum_cost:.2f} -> {'一致' if cost_ok else '不一致'}")
print(f"订单数: clean={clean_orders} vs monthly={sum_orders} -> {'一致' if orders_ok else '不一致'}")
if not (rev_ok and cost_ok and orders_ok):
    raise AssertionError("月度汇总与清洗明细不一致，血缘校验失败。")

# ---- 4. 关键指标（加权口径，非平均单笔毛利率）----
total_rev = sum_rev
total_cost = sum_cost
total_gp = total_rev - total_cost
total_gm = total_gp / total_rev if total_rev != 0 else float("nan")

print("\n=== 模拟数据 经营结果（单位：元）===")
print(f"总收入: {total_rev:.2f}")
print(f"总成本: {total_cost:.2f}")
print(f"总毛利: {total_gp:.2f}")
print(f"综合毛利率(加权): {total_gm:.4f}")
print(f"总订单数: {sum_orders}")

neg_months = ms[ms["gross_profit"] < 0]["month"].tolist()
print(f"毛利为负的月份: {neg_months if neg_months else '无'}")

# ---- 5. 绘图：收入/成本/毛利趋势 + 毛利率 ----
fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5))
x = np.arange(len(ms))
w = 0.28
ax1.bar(x - w, ms["revenue"], width=w, label="收入", color="#4C72B0")
ax1.bar(x, ms["cost"], width=w, label="成本", color="#DD8452")
ax1.bar(x + w, ms["gross_profit"], width=w, label="毛利", color="#55A868")
ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(ms["month"])
ax1.set_ylabel("金额（元）")
ax1.set_title("月度经营趋势（模拟数据，单位：元）")
ax1.legend(loc="upper left")

ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.plot(x, ms["gross_margin"], color="#C44E52", marker="o", linewidth=2, label="毛利率")
ax2.set_ylabel("毛利率")
ax2.axhline(0, color="gray", linestyle="--", linewidth=1)
ax2.legend(loc="upper right")

fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(OUT_FIG, format="svg")
plt.close(fig)
print(f"\n已生成矢量图: {OUT_FIG}")

# ---- 6. 生成管理层报告 report.md ----
lines = []
lines.append("# 月度经营报告（模拟数据）\n")
lines.append("> **重要声明：本报告全部基于模拟订单数据，仅用于方法演示，不代表任何公司真实经营情况。**\n")
lines.append("> 金额单位：**元**。\n")

lines.append("## 一、经营结果\n")
lines.append("| 指标 | 数值 |")
lines.append("| --- | --- |")
lines.append(f"| 总收入 | {total_rev:.2f} 元 |")
lines.append(f"| 总成本 | {total_cost:.2f} 元 |")
lines.append(f"| 总毛利 | {total_gp:.2f} 元 |")
lines.append(f"| 综合毛利率（加权） | {total_gm:.4f} |")
lines.append(f"| 总订单数 | {sum_orders} |\n")

lines.append("### 月度明细\n")
lines.append("| month | revenue | cost | gross_profit | gross_margin | orders |")
lines.append("| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |")
for _, r in ms.iterrows():
    lines.append(
        f"| {r['month']} | {r['revenue']:.2f} | {r['cost']:.2f} | "
        f"{r['gross_profit']:.2f} | {r['gross_margin']:.4f} | {int(r['orders'])} |"
    )
lines.append("")

lines.append("## 二、数据质量与血缘\n")
lines.append("- 数据来源：模拟订单明细经清洗（按 order_id 去重保留首条；收入或成本缺失剔除；保留毛利为负的有效订单）。")
lines.append("- 血缘核对：月度汇总总额与清洗明细总额一致（绝对容差 1e-8）。")
lines.append(f"- 毛利为负的月份：{neg_months if neg_months else '无'}。\n")

lines.append("## 三、毛利风险\n")
if neg_months:
    lines.append(f"- 存在毛利为负的月份：{', '.join(neg_months)}，需重点排查定价与成本结构。")
else:
    lines.append("- 各月毛利均为非负，但仍需关注毛利率偏低月份。")
low_gm = ms[ms["gross_margin"] < 0.2]["month"].tolist()
if low_gm:
    lines.append(f"- 毛利率低于 20% 的月份：{', '.join(low_gm)}，存在盈利承压风险。")
lines.append("- 风险提示：本结论基于模拟数据，不可直接用于真实经营决策。\n")

lines.append("## 四、行动建议\n")
lines.append("1. 对毛利为负或毛利率偏低的月份，复核定价策略与成本构成。")
lines.append("2. 建立月度毛利监控看板，设置毛利率预警阈值。")
lines.append("3. 补充真实数据后重新核算，验证本报告方法在真实场景下的适用性。\n")

lines.append("## 五、图表\n")
lines.append(f"- 趋势图见 `{OUT_FIG}`（矢量图，模拟数据，单位：元）。\n")

with open(OUT_REPORT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(lines))
print(f"已生成报告: {OUT_REPORT}")

# ---- 7. 验收：产物存在且标注模拟数据 ----
assert os.path.exists(OUT_FIG), "figure.svg 未生成"
assert os.path.exists(OUT_REPORT), "report.md 未生成"
with open(OUT_REPORT, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    content = f.read()
assert "模拟数据" in content, "报告未标注模拟数据"
print("\n验收通过：figure.svg 与 report.md 均存在，且报告明确标注为模拟数据。")

"""
步骤 1/3：清洗公开模拟订单数据 -> clean.csv
契约: input_files=[], output_files=['clean.csv']
规则:
  - 按 order_id 去重，保留首条
  - revenue 或 cost 缺失的订单剔除
  - 不剔除毛利为负的有效订单
注意: 本数据为【模拟数据】，不代表任何公司真实经营情况。
"""
import io
import pandas as pd

# ---- 模拟数据（内嵌，明确标注为模拟数据）----
RAW_CSV = """order_id,month,revenue,cost
X01,2026-05,250,120
X02,2026-05,750,600
X02,2026-05,750,600
X03,2026-05,,25
Y01,2026-06,1300,950
Y02,2026-06,400,440
Y03,2026-06,300,90
Z01,2026-07,2000,1200
Z02,2026-07,1000,700
Z03,2026-07,500,
"""

print("=" * 60)
print("【模拟数据】订单明细清洗（非真实经营数据）")
print("=" * 60)

raw = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(RAW_CSV), dtype={"order_id": str, "month": str})
raw["revenue"] = pd.to_numeric(raw["revenue"], errors="coerce")
raw["cost"] = pd.to_numeric(raw["cost"], errors="coerce")

n_raw = len(raw)
print(f"原始记录数: {n_raw}")

# ---- 1) 按 order_id 去重，保留首条 ----
dup_mask = raw.duplicated(subset=["order_id"], keep="first")
dup_count = int(dup_mask.sum())
dup_ids = raw.loc[dup_mask, "order_id"].tolist()
print(f"重复记录数(按 order_id 保留首条): {dup_count}  重复 order_id: {dup_ids}")

dedup = raw.loc[~dup_mask].copy()

# ---- 2) 剔除 revenue 或 cost 缺失的订单 ----
miss_mask = dedup["revenue"].isna() | dedup["cost"].isna()
miss_count = int(miss_mask.sum())
miss_ids = dedup.loc[miss_mask, "order_id"].tolist()

import os
import sys
import pandas as pd

# ============ 中文字体配置（本步骤不出图，但保留统一配置） ============
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

INPUT_FILE = "clean.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "monthly_summary.csv"
TOL = 1e-8

# ---------- 1. 读取前序产物，缺失即报错，禁止重造数据 ----------
if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
    sys.exit(f"[ERROR] 缺少约定输入文件 {INPUT_FILE}，本步骤拒绝重造数据。")

clean = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)
print(f"[INFO] 读取 {INPUT_FILE}：{len(clean)} 行，列={list(clean.columns)}")

# 契约校验：clean.csv 必须包含所需列
required = {"order_id", "month", "revenue", "cost"}
missing_cols = required - set(clean.columns)
if missing_cols:
    sys.exit(f"[ERROR] clean.csv 缺少必需列：{missing_cols}")

# 规避陷阱：clean.csv 应已去重且无缺失；此处做防御性检查并 print 结论
dup_cnt = int(clean.duplicated(subset=["order_id"]).sum())
na_rev = int(clean["revenue"].isna().sum())
na_cost = int(clean["cost"].isna().sum())
print(f"[CHECK] clean.csv 重复 order_id 数={dup_cnt}（应为0）；revenue缺失={na_rev}，cost缺失={na_cost}（应为0）")
if dup_cnt > 0 or na_rev > 0 or na_cost > 0:
    sys.exit("[ERROR] clean.csv 未满足清洗契约（去重/无缺失），请检查前序步骤。")

# 数值化，防止字符串
clean["revenue"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["revenue"], errors="coerce")
clean["cost"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["cost"], errors="coerce")
if clean["revenue"].isna().any() or clean["cost"].isna().any():
    sys.exit("[ERROR] clean.csv 存在无法转为数值的 revenue/cost。")

# ---------- 2. 按 month 汇总（不复制原始数据重算） ----------
# 规避陷阱：毛利率用「总毛利/总收入」，绝不对单笔毛利率取平均
grp = clean.groupby("month", as_index=False).agg(
    revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
    cost=("cost", "sum"),
    orders=("order_id", "nunique"),   # 订单数按唯一 order_id 计
)

# 毛利率：总毛利 / 总收入；总收入为0时置为 NaN 避免除零
grp["gross_margin"] = grp.apply(
    lambda r: (r["gross_profit"] / r["revenue"]) if r["revenue"] != 0 else float("nan"),
    axis=1,
)

# 列名严格为：month,revenue,cost,gross_profit,gross_margin,orders
monthly = grp[["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]].copy()

sum_cost = float(monthly["cost"].sum())
sum_profit = float(monthly["gross_profit"].sum())

det_cost = float(clean["cost"].sum())
det_profit = det_rev - det_cost

ok_rev = abs(sum_rev - det_rev) <= TOL
ok_cost = abs(sum_cost - det_cost) <= TOL
ok_profit = abs(sum_profit - det_profit) <= TOL
print(f"[VERIFY] 收入合计 汇总={sum_rev:.6f} 明细={det_rev:.6f} 一致={ok_rev}")
print(f"[VERIFY] 成本合计 汇总={sum_cost:.6f} 明细={det_cost:.6f} 一致={ok_cost}")
print(f"[VERIFY] 毛利合计 汇总={sum_profit:.6f} 明细={det_profit:.6f} 一致={ok_profit}")
if not (ok_rev and ok_cost and ok_profit):
    sys.exit("[ERROR] 月度汇总与清洗明细合计不一致，血缘校验失败。")

# 逐月毛利率再校验（总毛利/总收入）
for _, r in monthly.iterrows():
    if r["revenue"] != 0:
        expect = r["gross_profit"] / r["revenue"]
        assert abs(expect - r["gross_margin"]) <= TOL, f"{r['month']} 毛利率校验失败"
print("[VERIFY] 各月毛利率 = 总毛利/总收入，校验通过（未使用单笔毛利率平均）。")

# ---------- 4. 打印关键结果 ----------
print("\n[RESULT] 月度汇总（模拟数据，金额单位：元）")
print(monthly.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\n[RESULT] 月份数={len(monthly)}，总订单数={int(monthly['orders'].sum())}，"
      f"总收入={sum_rev:.2f}，总成本={sum_cost:.2f}，总毛利={sum_profit:.2f}")

# ---------- 5. 落盘 ----------
monthly.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
